meta.title: Runlang
meta.description:
Runlang: a courtyard-video skin for the DSH Web UI - a bundled 4K courtyard loop behind smoked-glass panels with depth presets; a wallpaper panel for uploads, GLSL scenes and Wallpaper Engine libraries; a corner music player (order / loop / repeat-one / shuffle, draggable frame-accurate bar); composer chips for wallpaper transparency, glass opacity and the background video''s soundtrack; a reasoning rail drawn by nine canvas effects that lists every effort tier - including seven-tier GPT/Codex models - and cycles its effect on right-click; twelve companions (Baili''s official sprite sheet plus five hand-drawn pixel pets) that walk, nap, fight, get poked, react to reasoning and celebrate finished turns; and an opening animation that is the built-in film or any clip uploaded from the material library. Low-power aware; settings and uploads live under the profile''s runlang/ directory.'
  zh: 'Runlang：DSH Web 界面的庭院动态壁纸皮肤——随包 4K 庭院循环片铺在烟熏玻璃面板之后，玻璃有多档深浅；壁纸面板支持上传、GLSL 场景与 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库；右上角音乐播放器有顺序 / 循环 / 单曲 / 随机和可拖动的逐帧进度条；输入框下方的胶囊调壁纸透明度、玻璃不透明度和壁纸视频自带声音；推理滑杆由九种 Canvas 动效绘制，点档位名列出全部档位（含 GPT/Codex 七档），右键换动效；十二只桌宠（白璃官方图集 + 五只手绘像素宠）会散步、睡觉、打架、被戳被拎、被推理风吹、在回答结束时撒花；开场动画可用内置片头、简版，或直接从素材库上传的视频/图片。自带低电量与「减弱动态效果」适配；设置与素材在 profile 的 runlang/ 目录。 First run: press Alt+W (Option+W on macOS) for the wallpaper panel, and turn off Tianlight or other full-window skins before refreshing.
